Card Q&A.q: If my opponent uses the effect on a card like [BT2-041 ShineGreymon] to suspend 2 or more of their Tamers, does this card's inherited effect allow me to gain a memory for each Tamer suspended?

Effect: [Opponent's Turn] When an opponent plays a Tamer, gain 3 memory.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] When an opponent's Tamer becomes suspended, gain 1 memory.
